title: Moss and the Moon Kite
retell: Tell me the problem Moss had, and how Fern and Moss fixed it together.

pages.text: Moss is a little green dragon. He lives on a hill by a deep lake.
Moss cannot fly yet. His wings are still too little. Each night he sits and looks up at the moon.
"I wish I could float up there," he said with a sigh.
Fern the rabbit hopped up the hill. She had a red kite with a long tail.
"We can make a moon kite," said Fern. "A big one, for a dragon."
They used sticks, string and a big sheet. Moss puffed and puffed. Hot air filled the sheet.
The kite lifted. Moss held on tight with his claws. Up, up, up he went!
The wind sang. The stars were bright. The lake shone like a silver plate.
Then the wind dropped. The kite began to sink. "Help!" yelled Moss.
Fern ran and tugged the string. Moss landed with a soft bump in the grass.
"That was the best night," said Moss. "One day my wings will grow, and I will take you up with me."

questions.q: What filled the kite with hot air?
How do you think Fern felt when Moss yelled for help?
What would you make so a friend could fly?
